first.rationale: Onboarding simplification most directly addresses the completion decline and may also recover activation by accelerating time-to-value. I would verify its downstream adoption evidence while comparing it with activation messaging and promotional pricing. Pricing is responsive to the competitor threat, but its retention and long-term revenue quality remain uncertain.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified evidence directly addresses the 4% completion decline and previously improved completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention by 3%, making it the strongest option for sustainable revenue. Activation messaging is credible but had a smaller retention lift. Promotional pricing is rejected despite competitive pressure because its 12% retention loss undermines long-term qualified revenue. Monitor activation, retention, and qualified-revenue guardrails because current-period effects may differ from the archived experiment.
